title: Sparkly magnifying glass
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- handle -->
  <rect x='60' y='60' width='14' height='34' rx='7' transform='rotate(-45 67 77)' fill='#c47a2b'/>
  <rect x='63' y='63' width='8' height='28' rx='4' transform='rotate(-45 67 77)' fill='#f0b060'/>
  <!-- glass lens -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='42' r='26' fill='#2aa8c8'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='42' r='26' fill='#7fe3f5' opacity='0.55'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='42' r='20' fill='#bff4fb' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- lens rim -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='42' r='26' fill='none' stroke='#ffd23f' stroke-width='6'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='42' r='26' fill='none' stroke='#fff2a8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- shine on lens -->
  <path d='M28 30 Q34 24 42 24' fill='none' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffe066'>
    <path d='M78 22 l3 7 7 3 -7 3 -3 7 -3 -7 -7 -3 7 -3 z'/>

  <g fill='#b8f0ff'>
    <path d='M86 58 l2 4 4 2 -4 2 -2 4 -2 -4 -4 -2 4 -2 z'/>

</svg>
